description: We offers you an exceptional apartment air-conditionned in Paris. With a surface area of ​​65 m² on the fifth floor, this spacious accommodation includes three modern bedrooms, ideal for optimal comfort. Nestled in the heart of the dynamic Sentier district, you will be close to numerous monuments and emblematic sites, including the majestic Porte Saint-Denis.The spaceDiscover this magnificent apartment for rent in the heart of Paris, offering an exceptional living environment and optimal comfort. This elegant and modern accommodation is designed to accommodate up to 8 people. The refined decoration combines Parisian charm with a contemporary style, creating a harmonious and welcoming living space. It is ideal for families or groups wishing to stay in the heart of the capital.The Sentier district is renowned for its vibrant and cosmopolitan atmosphere. Right in the center of Paris, it is the meeting place for creatives and professionals from the world of fashion and new technologies. Here you will find a multitude of trendy cafes, trendy boutiques and diverse restaurants, offering a dynamic and inspiring urban living experience. Its proximity to historic monuments like the Porte Saint-Denis adds a touch of cultural heritage to this modern environment.For your comfort, the apartment is equipped with: ➜ A living room with a sofa bed to relax in after a busy day, providing a comfortable and welcoming space to gather with family or friends.➜ Three bedrooms with three double beds to ensure restful and comfortable sleep, with each room tastefully appointed to create a relaxing atmosphere.➜ An elegant dining area to enjoy convivial meals, whether for a sunny breakfast or a candlelit dinner, in a refined setting.➜ A fully equipped kitchen with a hob, kettle, and all the utensils
